subject: Compact Eval Playbook & MAP — kickoff and doc seed
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novaware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compact Eval Playbook & MAP — kickoff and doc seed

Hi Evan / Sophia —

Thanks again for a great demo last week. Per our conversation I sketched a compact evaluation playbook (MAP-lite) to help Novaware get a working integration in a 30–45 day window. The goal is to keep things time-boxed: two technical milestones (integration + perf validation) and one business milestone (acceptance criteria + exec sign-off).

Attached: a one-page starter map and a short checklist for pilot gating. I also seeded a Google Doc and a 5-slide kickoff deck (links below) so we can co-edit the MAP and assign owners.

Suggested next steps:
- Evan: confirm the two engineering owners we should loop in for the integration milestone
- Sophia: confirm the weekly sync cadence (30 min preferred) and stakeholders for acceptance sign-off
- Marissa / Ben: I'll hand off the MAP draft and slide owners to you for technical pairing and demo readiness

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-compact-map-seed (MAP draft)
Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XyZ-compact-map-slides

Thanks — I’ll update the doc once I have the engineering contacts and sync cadence.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions PM
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: compact-map-starter.pdf (PDF), pilot-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novaware.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophia Kim <sophia.kim@novaware.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact Eval Playbook & MAP — kickoff and doc seed

Thanks, Jasmine — this is helpful. Quick notes:
- I'll add Aisha Khan (aisha.khan@novaware.com) and Miguel Ortega (miguel.ortega@novaware.com) as the two engineers for integration. They'll join the weekly sync.
- Sophia and I prefer Tue at 10am PT for a 30-minute standing sync; Sophia will invite.
- Acceptance: we need an SLA smoke test (90th p50 < 600ms on our test traffic) plus a short user-demo to the product committee.

I'll edit the MAP doc directly with owners. Looking forward to pairing on the integration plan.

—Evan
Director, Platform Engineering
Novaware Systems

Great starter, Jasmine. I'll take point on the integration milestone and pair with Miguel for the first week. Ben — can you own the perf validation plan (tooling + synthetic tests)?

I made two small edits in the doc: added a minimal KV cache test under perf validation and a checklist item to capture test dataset ownership.

Marissa

- We'll need a small synthetic dataset (50k tokens) and an instrumented client for p50/p90 capture.
- Suggest adding a fallback acceptance: if 90th p95 > 600ms, then we document improvement steps and retest within 7 days before final acceptance.

I'll post updates directly to the MAP doc and add the runbook as an attached stub.
